scientific.integrity: All local equations are obtained directly from the published defining polynomial. Smoothness, singular support, contact orders and the localized Tjurina algebra are replayed exactly over the rationals by the included verifier; the monodromy follows from the stated embedded resolution via A'Campo's formula.
limitations: The two five-branch germs are described by branch contacts, resolution data and numerical invariants; no named analytic modality class is asserted.
The result concerns this explicit arrangement and does not classify other nearly-free degree-nine conic–line arrangements.

title: Local singularity census and Tjurina-defect split for a nearly-free conic–line arrangement
